en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard titled "Mooi Nederland." The left side shows a romanticized illustration of an armored trumpeter on horseback by a large tree, overlooking a broad rural landscape. The right side is a panoramic view of rolling fields, scattered trees, small roads and farmhouses, with people walking in the foreground and a bird flying above. At the bottom is an ornate coat of arms flanked by decorative text panels in Dutch.
